name: dm_trail
label: Death Mountain Trail
about: Pieces and textures cut from Death Mountain Trail (spot16). Definitions only: the meshes come from the extract (ROM data) into out/. Coordinates are the builder's: x east, y north, z up (glTF's (x, -z, y)). See ADR 0036.

textures.about: Material N -> role (2026-10-09, from the textures and where the trail draws them). The trail's floors are `ground_rough` (and `_b`), `sand` and the streaky `ground` family (which doesn't tile seamlessly across u), the big outer slopes `dirt`; its walls `cliff` (mottled rock and dirt), `cliff_band` (low ledges), `rock` (the layered strata of the big west walls) and `rock_wall` (dark streaked rock round the Goron City approach). `mountain*` are the coarse striated peaks, `climb_wall` the stakes on the climbable wall below the summit, `gate_wall`/`gate_floor`/`banner`/`palisade` the Goron City gate, `tunnel_*`, `cave_*` and `dark_*` the cave mouths and their fades to black, `lava`/`lava_glow` the crater passage (vertex-coloured), `backdrop_*` the far mountains and Kakariko cards. No floor has a detail texture.

surfaces.about: Surface type -> collision role (oot_import::level::ROLES), where the default read off the type (kit::default_role) is wrong.

pieces.name: dmt_goron_gate
pieces.label: Goron City gate
pieces.about: The stone-framed passage to Goron City, with Goron banners over its mouth and its palisade gates open inside; exit 2's floor starts 40 in. The origin is the wall's face at the sill, facing out; the tunnel runs 1237 back and may be shortened (y scale).

pieces.name: dmt_dodongo_cave
pieces.label: Dodongo's Cavern mouth
pieces.about: The long, dark tunnel to Dodongo's Cavern (low on the trail's west side; a bombable boulder, an actor, blocks it in the game). The origin is the mouth's floor on the wall's face, facing out; exit 4's floor starts 340 in, and the tunnel may be shortened (y scale).

pieces.name: dmt_fairy_cave
pieces.label: Great Fairy cave mouth
pieces.about: The cave at the summit leading to the Great Fairy's fountain (a bombable wall, an actor, hides it in the game). The origin is its mouth's floor, facing out; exit 5's floor starts about 90 in.

pieces.name: dmt_crater_passage
pieces.label: Crater passage
pieces.about: The summit's way into Death Mountain Crater: a plank threshold, then a rock tunnel lit red by the lava beyond (the lava glow is vertex-coloured). The origin is the mouth's floor, facing out; exit 3's floors start 240 in. Locked size.

pieces.name: dmt_climb_wall
pieces.label: Stake climbing wall
pieces.about: The wall of stakes driven into the rock below the summit: climbable (wall type 4). Placed on a wall's face; its texture repeats as it grows.

pieces.name: dmt_stone_block
pieces.label: Stone block
pieces.about: A stone-walled block with a dirt top, 200 square and 61 tall, in front of the Goron City gate.

pieces.name: dmt_palisade
pieces.label: Palisade gate leaf
pieces.about: One leaf of the Goron City gate's palisade (a single card, 110 wide and 168 tall), as it stands open inside the passage.

pieces.name: dmt_rope_fence
pieces.label: Rope fence
pieces.about: A translucent lashed-rope fence, 900 long, along the trail's edge below the Goron City gate; it climbs 228 over its length, so it fits a slope. Collides (wood).

pieces.name: dmt_post_fence
pieces.label: Post fence pen
pieces.about: A little fenced pen of wooden post cards on the ledge above Dodongo's Cavern, with fence runs leading off both ways; its top collides as wood.
